exact_prefix_comparison.interpretation: The failed cohort bytes, including all 105 recorded parent identities, are exactly reproduced as the successful retry prefix. This rules out a necessary deterministic failure at that input boundary, but not intermittent environmental or implementation faults.

independent_checks: Both command and reader receipt states are terminal and their before/after source identities match the exact tested source.
All four receipt log byte lengths and SHA-256 values recomputed from raw files.
Binary independently rehashed with stable size/mtime; source binding and profile preserved.
Every original/retry JSONL file parsed with complete newline; hashes retained, including the incomplete original cohort.
All 72 retry sample IDs, native admission/activation returns, stage data, median intervals and full-state equality checked against raw cohort rows.
All nine deliberate cancelled return records preserve rows and active generation; all nine cold reopen summaries retain full-state equality.
All retry JSONL fingerprints agree with the formal reader output.
All 72 callback counts equal 3*min(parent_height,16); CPU fields and p99 remain null.
Original a64h128 complete byte sequence and all 105 warmup parent records exactly match the successful retry prefix.
Monitor source hash and unchanged native argv suffix verified; statvfs bounds computed from all 6592 samples.

measurement_interpretation.cold_journal_peak_rows_scope: Retained rows measured by the specific cold-journal verifier; not total open-state memory, RSS or SQL traffic
measurement_interpretation.cold_reopen_scope: Node::open_with_permanent_account_growth_v2 wall interval only; post-open complete-State checks and explicit journal differential are separate
limitations: Native stage timers measure inclusive wall time only; thread_cpu_ns and process_cpu_ns are null. Nested offsets and intervals must not be summed.
The eight-observation median interval is the fourth and fifth sorted observations; it is neither a confidence interval nor a p99 estimate.
Packet/signature/full-W1 construction, setup, complete-State reference diagnostics and journal append/fsync are outside each native admission/activation timer but remain campaign cost.

The diagnostic retry adds an external Python process and statvfs polling. There is no randomized, paired or otherwise controlled performance comparison against the failed attempt; no speedup or regression is inferred from their timings.

The debug=0 package override preserves opt-level=3, overflow checks and debug assertions for functional validation, but does not establish the original debug-info profile or F0 performance acceptance.
Archive point reads are from the separate successor multiproof query; header_ancestors counts callbacks. Neither is a count of all SQL, epoch/schema fences, CPU work or total admission work.
The fixture preallocates 64/1024/16384 accounts and retains real 0/16/128-block warmup histories. It does not replace the separate 65,536 signed account-growth gate.
This is direct native Node validation, not public ingress, WAN, client inclusion/independent confirmation, confirmation TPS, production activation or whole-chain PQ qualification.
The original failed run remains failed and incomplete. A successful retry does not identify the original root cause or remove that failure from the record.
measurement_interpretation.median_interval_definition: Fourth and fifth sorted values of eight native stage wall-time observations; no averaging or confidence-interval claim
measurement_interpretation.point_read_scope: Separate successor multiproof query over the fixed three account owners; not total SQL
measurement_interpretation.units: raw timings in nanoseconds; Markdown tables render milliseconds

original_failure_analysis.best_supported_hypothesis: A transient failure while writing the stderr mirror is compatible with the complete synced JSONL record, the 4096-aligned truncated mirror and later libtest summary. Rust eprintln can panic on stderr write failure. Exact OS error and original root cause were not captured.
original_failure_analysis.deterministic_boundary_review: The fixed candidate timestamps remain valid relative to now=100000 and strictly increasing median ancestry; classic measured expiry remains above height 137. Fixed 10-second spacing keeps the 16-header retarget interval at observed=desired=150. The retry completed the exact same warmup prefix and all original limits unchanged.
original_failure_analysis.missing_return_policy: Do not synthesize a native return or successful completion for the uncompleted original cohort.
not_established: make/admit returned an error at warmup index 104
deterministic fixture capacity or timestamp failure
original_failure_analysis.recorder_behavior: create-only binary log file; subprocess stdout points to it and stderr is redirected to stdout; no content filter or size cap in recorder
original_failure_analysis.source_panic_hook_audit: No set_hook/take_hook occurrence in workspace Rust crates; no catch_unwind in the scale fixture/warmup path reviewed. This does not instrument the standard library or prove every dependency hook absent.

limitations: Only the retry is monitored; no contemporaneous original-run trace exists.
Samples describe the whole filesystem containing the validation directory, including unrelated activity; they are not per-process disk use or peak allocation.
A roughly 50-ms sampling interval can miss shorter excursions and does not capture a failed write or its errno.
available_bytes=0 throughout a successful run does not itself prove a write failure or ENOSPC; free_bytes remained positive at every recorded sample.
The source records no shared monotonic timestamps for cohort events, so these samples are not assigned to individual native stages.
The monitor creates scheduling/filesystem overhead; its wall timings are not a paired performance control.
